title: Strobe
description: A heavy direct-drive turntable seen low at the platter's edge, its machined strobe dots lit by a flickering neon lamp. Ride the weighted pitch fader into its centre detent and the 33 row freezes dead still while the others crawl, with the record's pitch following the platter.
intent: One optical instrument finished to the edge: the strobe dots are sampled at the lamp's real flash times, so the stillness you chase with the fader is the same stroboscopic beat a DJ reads off a real deck.
